annotations.title: List documents that outlived their use

description: List documents that have probably outlived their use - by default unchanged for a year, never read and linked from nowhere, or what the folder's declared stale query names - each with when its file last changed and why; with path, only that document or those under that folder. Use it to suggest what to archive; Folio only lists them and never moves or deletes anything. For documents the reader should catch up on use folio_changes instead, and for everything wrong in the folder folio_health. It reveals which documents the reader never read. While the reader pauses sharing in Folio, it answers only {paused: true, message}. Answers {ready, documents: [{path, changed: ISO time, why}], version: the same while the list is}; ready false, with no documents, while Folio still reads the folder. A list cut to fit one answer adds omitted, the entries each list left out, and narrow, how to ask for less.

path.description: A document, relative to the served folder or absolute under it, such as notes/plan.md, or a folder, such as notes/; omit for the whole folder
